desc: It's understood that you get more with a Browning Golden Clays model shotgun. More "ooohs," more "ahhhs," and certainly more compliments. In addition to the envious accolades that come from friends and competitors alike when they lay eyes upon this handsome over and under, the Golden Clays Sporting includes all the performance features that make the Citori 825 great, resulting in more busted clays. The Citori 825 is the latest in the storied lineage of Browning over and under shotguns that began with John M. Browning and his legendary B25 Superposed. This new model shares a number of features with the original, the most important being the easy handling prowess that feels nothing short of intuitive. It is quick to the shoulder, natural to point, and effortless to swing.
